highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Kennesaw State University (KSU), founded in 1963, is a public research university in Georgia state. It is ranked among the top public universities in the South by U.S. News & World Report (2025).

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value:
Kennesaw State University boasts a vibrant student life. With over 200 student organisations, you can engage in various academic, cultural, and recreational activities.

KSU also offers comprehensive mental health and wellness support through their Counselling and Psychological Services. These services provide confidential counselling, workshops on stress management, and other programs designed to help your well-being.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Kennesaw State University offers on-campus housing options for students. You can choose from dormitory-style rooms to suite-style accommodations. All the stay options are located close to the campus to make your study life easier.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
Kennesaw State University is home to the Sturgis Library, a state-of-the-art academic resource centre. The library provides you with individual study spaces, group study rooms, computer stations, and access to many digital resources, including online journals and databases.

Sports
KSU offers a comprehensive array of sports and recreational activities through its well-equipped Recreation and Wellness Centre. The University's athletic teams, the Kennesaw State Owls, compete at the NCAA Division I level in sports such as basketball, baseball, soccer, and track and field.

The university’s fitness facilities include a large gymnasium, weight rooms, and fitness studios. You can also enjoy outdoor spaces, including athletic fields and walking trails.

Laboratory
The College of Science and Mathematics at KSU houses specialised labs for fields like biology, chemistry, and physics. There are several engineering labs and centres as well.

Moreover, the WellStar College of Health and Human Services is equipped with cutting-edge labs for nursing and health sciences, providing you with hands-on experience in clinical simulation and healthcare training.

Cafeteria
KSU is ranked 10 out of 1344 for Best College Food in America. The University’s main dining hall offers a buffet-style dining experience with a wide selection of meals. If you’re in a rush, you can visit one of the campus cafes or food kiosks for a quick snack or meal.
